name: Grok for Word
desc: Word add-in that turns notes into styled documents with web research.
desc_zh: Word 加载项，把笔记变成文档、做好排版并带入网页资料。
solves: Drafts start from a blank page and the research sits in another tab; the add-in writes paragraphs and pulls the material in.
solves_zh: 初稿总从空白页开始，查好的资料又在另一个标签页里；加载项直接写段落，并把内容带进文档。
best_for: You have messy meeting notes and a document due that still needs outside references.
best_for_zh: 手里只有一堆乱会议记录，而文档还等着要交、又需要外部引用时。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — x.ai/news directory; channel A Microsoft Marketplace listing）。 First of the four Grok Office add-ins. The marketplace URL redirects by dropping the locale segment. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：嵌在办公软件里的助手，与账本对同类功能的分类一致。 首次公开日期来源：https://x.ai/news/introducing-word-addin 官网未直接确认（redirect->https://marketplace.microsoft.com/en-us/product/WA200011055?tab=Overview）。
